parameters.name: api_timeout
parameters.description: HTTP timeout to Online API in seconds. Default: 30

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Validate SSL certs of the Online API. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Gather Online user info
  community.general.online_user_info:
  register: result

- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ result.online_user_info }}"

return_values.name: online_user_info
return_values.description: Response from Online API. For more details please refer to: https://console.online.net/en/api/. Returned: success Sample: {"company": "foobar LLC", "email": "foobar@example.com", "first_name": "foo", "id": 42, "last_name": "bar", "login": "foobar"}
